_comment: Client-JS budgets enforced by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs in CI. Raw KB (uncompressed). routeFirstLoadKB is the real page-load guard (heaviest route's JS on open); totalClientKB is a loose cap on all chunks, lazy ones included. If a real feature legitimately grows the bundle, raise the relevant limit here and say why in the commit. See docs/perf.md.
